snippet.title: "Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" PlayStation™5 & Xbox Series X|S versions Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
"Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" is a Japanese-style horror TPS game where you can fight back against the spirits. 
Developed by indie game developer "Noto Muteki," the Steam version was released in October 2024. The game's unique concept of being a "horror game where you can fight back against unreasonable spirits that are immune to bullets and fists," typical in Japanese horror, has captivated many players. 
Now, in order to make "Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" available to as many people as possible, AMATA Games has taken charge of porting and distributing the game to the PlayStation™5 & Xbox Series X|S, and today, the game is available for download on the PlayStation™Store and Microsoft Store(XBOX).

PlayStation™Store:
 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014681/
Microsoft Store(XBOX):
 https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nd5hjr0xttf

AMATA Games "Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau"
 https://amata.games/en/game/kinki-spiritual-affairs-bureau/
